item.taczammobox.box.place: Right-click air to unpack; sneak-right-click block to place; right-click pile to take; sneak-right-click pile to add
jei.taczammobox.ammo_chain.info1: While carried, guns reload straight from boxed, crated, TACZ ammo boxes or loose rounds instead of ammo boxes.
jei.taczammobox.ammo_chain.info2: The reload animation and cooldown stay vanilla; leftover rounds are cached in the belt.
item.taczammobox.ammo_chain.desc: While carried, TACZ guns reload straight from boxed or crated ammo instead of ammo boxes. The reload animation and cooldown still apply.
item.taczammobox.ammo_belt.desc: Automatically feeds the main-hand gun from compressed ammo boxes in your inventory when its magazine is below full. No manual reload required.
item.taczammobox.ammo_belt.quote: Carrying an entire armory means I cannot lose. I will win.
